answer: The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, clawed back after a replayed submission, quorum must span unrelated subnetworks. Work waits on the ocean until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the grove of the next round. The knoll of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
